versions.changelog:
runse-skill 1.0.5

Updated to three levels: Light processing: Flash – breaks down the AI skeleton; Medium processing: Pro – fine-tunes words and sentences for precise handling; Heavy processing: Pro_plus – super processing. The three processing levels can be combined for better results. I usually use medium processing. Sometimes I combine light processing with medium processing. Heavy processing takes time, so patience is needed.

**Major update: Expanded processing options and improved privacy handling.**

- Added three selectable processing modes: flash (breaking AI skeleton), pro (sentence-level humanization), and pro_plus (deep, one-shot AI-trace removal).
- Updated trigger rules: only processes when the user clearly requests "去AI味", "降AI味", "润色", "改写", etc., and provides a text.
- Enhanced privacy: all processing through stateless cloud functions, with no text storage or context retention.
- Out-of-the-box use: free public key, no configuration required, no account needed.
- More flexible key management: personal keys are only saved locally following explicit user consent, with customizable file paths.
- Removed unused or outdated documentation files (e.g., skill-card.md).

- 默认“开箱即用”：内置免费公共密钥，安装后无需注册和配置即可直接体验所有润色和排版功能
- 新增“进阶”说明，明确绑定个人密钥为可选，无需提前注册
- 相关描述、欢迎语、提示文案同步强调零配置和免费使用
- 功能触发、执行流程、本地隐私等机制无变动

Version 1.0.2 of runse-skill

- No file changes detected; internal or meta-information update only.
- Skill logic, user instructions, and capabilities remain unchanged.

runse-skill 1.0.1

- Updated documentation: consolidated main README and scripts to the top level, removing redundant subfolders and legacy docs.
- Enhanced SKILL.md with improved privacy and data usage guidance.
- Clarified trigger rules, emphasizing script invocation over direct text rewriting.
- Refined instructions on personal key binding, usage tips, and error messaging.
- Reduced total file count for a cleaner structure.

wenzi-runse 1.0.0

- Initial release of the AI Text Humanizer (Polish & Format skill) for novels, articles, and copywriting.
- Supports three modes: polish (remove AI flavor), format (optimize paragraphs), and one-shot polish+format.
- Fully preserves original meaning—no deletions, forced synonym swaps, or templating; output quality matches input.
- Works on text >300 characters; provides error if under minimum length.
- Allows use of personal API keys or defaults to built-in public key.
- Automatically triggers based on user intent and keywords like “polish,” “rewrite,” “remove AI flavor,” etc.
